Deploy Aspen2 and verify authenticated worker registration and bounded automatic publication.
Deploy and verify Aspen3, Bonsai, and britton-desktop only after primary and worker health pass. britton-fw is excluded and need not be brought online.
Exercise a real scheduled build and signed-cache reuse against the deployed farm; isolated VM proof is not a substitute for this live acceptance check.
